summary: OpenAI launched Presence, an enterprise product that deploys voice and chat AI agents for customer and internal workflows, combining policies, guardrails, and a Codex-powered improvement loop, with limited general availability through OpenAI's Forward Deployed Engineers.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI reports its own agent deployment resolving the large majority of inbound support requests without human involvement, an at-scale measurement of agents displacing human-staffed workflows.
mechanisms.quote: Within weeks, it met or exceeded benchmarks we use to grade frontline human-support quality and now resolves 75% of inbound issues without human assistance.

practices.reason: A production agent-improvement loop that proposes and tests policy/behavior updates from live escalation data is a transferable pattern, though it is currently tied to OpenAI's own Codex-Presence tooling.
practices.quote: Working with our launch team, its Codex-powered improvement loop reduced human handoffs by 15 percentage points in just 10 days.

practices.reason: The described pre-launch simulation and grading process for checking outcome correctness, policy adherence, tool use and escalation is a methodology worth adapting for evaluating our own agents, though the instrument itself is not handed over.
practices.quote: Simulations and graders check whether it reached the right outcome, followed policy, used tools correctly, and escalated when appropriate.
